The '''vrake''' was a species native to [[Makeb]]. The vrake came very near to extinction until an enterprising scientist named [[Kaylah Taprish]] took a liking to the creatures. After five years of study and crossbreeding, Taprish released a dozen colonies of the vrake into the wild. Due to increased numbers, the vrake became more aggressively territorial.<ref name="Vrake" />
